_comment: Copy this file to ~/.config/needmoretokens/gemini-oauth.json and fill in agy's (Antigravity's) OAuth client to enable automatic Gemini token refresh. NMT reads it at runtime; it is NOT committed (no OAuth secret lives in this repo). If the file is absent or wrong, Gemini shows 'expired — run agy' once its ~1h token lapses. Use agy's OWN client_id+secret — the client the Keychain token (gemini/antigravity) was issued under; obtain it by capturing agy's refresh POST to https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token. NOTE: gemini-cli's public client does NOT work — its tokens are rejected (HTTP 403) by the Code Assist quota API.
